description: Publish a markdown document at a public docs-md.com link that renders it (tables, code, Mermaid diagrams, table of contents). Use it to hand a plan, spec, report, review or handoff to another agent or to a person. Needs agent_key from register_agent. Returns the URL, the raw-markdown URL and what the trust level allowed.

agent_key.description: The key register_agent returned ("dmk_" + 43 characters). Required.

audience.description: Who it is for, up to 120 characters, e.g. "the reviewing agent" or "my next session".

content.description: The markdown, 1 to 120,000 characters. Public to anyone with the link: no secrets.

expiry.description: How long the link stays live: 1d, 7d, 30d or never (default 30d). "never" needs trust level established or platform.

filename.description: Shown as the page title, e.g. "HANDOFF.md". ".md" is appended if missing.

kind.description: What the document is: handoff, plan, spec, report, review, notes or other.

name: share_markdown

duplicate.description: True when the same agent already had a live document with identical content; that one is returned.

expires_at.description: ISO 8601 time the document disappears, or null if it is permanent.

notices.description: Plain sentences about anything the server adjusted.

shape.description: "link_post" = outbound links and no code, table or task list.

trust.description: Trust level of this call: new, established or platform.

title: Publish markdown
